routes.detail: Structured one to three year programmes with rotations and training. Usually open a year ahead, with online tests and assessment centres.
Short placements that convert into offers. Apply six to nine months before the start date, even in your second year.
SETA-funded programmes combining work experience with a qualification. Listed by employers, SETAs and the national jobs portal.
NYSC placement year; use the primary assignment to target an organisation in your field rather than accepting a random posting.
Paid roles in a university department that build a research record and often lead to funded postgraduate study.
Graduate recruitment into government, plus fellowships such as Global Health Corps and similar leadership programmes.

checklist: The CV mirrors the job advert's words for skills you genuinely have.
Every claim has evidence: a number, a result or a named project.
The cover letter names the organisation and the role, not a generic employer.
Referees have agreed in advance and know which role they are supporting.
File names are clean and the PDF opens on a phone.
You recorded the closing date and applied at least three days early.
